profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA. It trades under the ticker NVDA and reported revenue of 215938000000 USD for the period ending 2026-01-25 in its 10-K filing. Its SEC central index key is 0001045810.

On its own site, NVIDIA describes the NVIDIA Nemotron family as multimodal, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents, with agentic reasoning aimed at graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding. The company says Nemotron models are available as NVIDIA NIM microservices for deployment, and that NIM requires an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. It states that it publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques under the NVIDIA Open Model License, a permissive license allowing use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA. Related tools named on the page include NVIDIA NeMo, NVIDIA Blueprints, NVIDIA Dynamo, and TensorRT-LLM, along with the open-source libraries SGLang and vLLM. The page also names Bryan Catanzaro, VP of applied deep learning research at NVIDIA, and mentions ServiceNow in connection with evaluation of Nemotron model weights, datasets, and training recipes.

The site lists two tracked products: NVIDIA Nemotron, an enterprise LLM family with synthetic data generation, GPU optimization, and self-hosted options, and NVIDIA NIM, inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. The company's recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
